findings.title: The panel's section labels are small and pale

location.description: The words Decided and To do inside the notes panel.

findings.viewer_experience: A viewer scanning the sample has to find where the decisions end and the tasks begin, and the labels are easy to miss.

current.value: Small grey labels on a pale grey panel.

findings.target: Each section label is easy to read against the panel.
findings.fix_direction: Raise the contrast of the labels, and make them a little larger or heavier.

closed_when.check: Looking at the panel, the two labels are as easy to read as the lines below them.

findings.title: The day of each task sits far from its text

location.description: The right-hand column of the To do list.

findings.viewer_experience: The eye has to cross the whole row to match Mon, Wed or Fri to a task.

current.value: Day names at the far right edge, with a wide gap after the task text.

findings.target: A task and its day read as one line.
findings.fix_direction: Bring the day closer to the task, or add a faint guide across the row.

closed_when.check: Looking at the list, a reader can match each day to its task without tracing across the row.
